text:
I can't give you a tree-cover change status for ASSET-K. The analysis did not produce any result.

The land-change run (run-1, 12 Nov 2026) was configured with a 31 Dec 2020 baseline, a 30% tree-cover threshold, a 0.5 ha minimum event size, and the Hansen/UMD and JRC GFC2020 datasets. But the zonal statistics step failed with this message: "the source coverage this asset needs has not been prepared; no observation was made." So nothing was measured for this asset. The asset area is also blank in the metadata.

This is not evidence of "no tree-cover loss." It means the question is unanswered.

To get an answer, the source coverage for ASSET-K needs to be prepared and the run repeated. Also note that the engine is labeled early access (land-change/1). Once a result exists, check it against the stated corroboration rule: a later year must be observed, and the JRC 2020 reference must agree on at least 50% of the event area.
